summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Adega Delivery white-label app. 23/23 pytest backend tests passing (config, auth, categories, products, orders, admin guards, stats). UI tested end-to-end via Playwright: storefront load + 11 cards, category & search filter, cart add/persist/checkout, register auto-login, admin login + dashboard stats + admin pages + orders list. All critical flows work correctly. Two minor frontend deviations from spec around search debounce and one testid name.

ui_bugs.issue: Search only updates parent state on onBlur / form submit (Enter), not 'as user types'. Spec requires live filtering as the user types. Fix: change Input onChange to also call setSearch(value) (or debounce 200ms).
Uses data-testid='detail-add-to-cart' instead of the documented 'add-to-cart-btn-{id}'. Either rename for consistency or update the data-testid spec.

action_items: Fix Storefront search to filter products live as user types (currently only on blur/Enter) — update Header.jsx Input onChange to invoke setSearch (or debounce).
Optional: rename ProductDetail add-to-cart data-testid to 'add-to-cart-btn-{id}' for consistency with spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORSMiddleware uses allow_origin_regex='https?://.*' with allow_credentials=True. This effectively allows any origin to send credentials and is unsafe. Restrict to explicit FRONTEND_URL origin.

server.py: `set_auth_cookies` always sets secure=True samesite='none', which is correct for the deployed environment, but cookies will not work over plain http (e.g., local dev). Acceptable for the hosted preview but worth a comment.

server.py: /api/orders accepts arbitrary unit_price from the client (used for total computation). Backend trusts the client price — a malicious customer could submit a R$ 0.01 unit_price. Recommend looking up product price server-side to compute totals.
server.py: Pydantic Literal on payment_method correctly returns 422 for invalid values — good.
Header.jsx: search input uses two sources of truth (localSearch + parent search) — simplify with a single debounced onChange.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows pass; 2 minor deviations noted)

test_credentials: Admin admin@adega.com / admin123 (seeded). Customers created at runtime via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create a fresh customer e2e_customer_<rand>@adega.com per run and a few TEST_ prefixed categories/products that are cleaned up in-test. UI flow created 1 guest order, 1 customer order, and registered e2e_ui_<ts>@adega.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid. If main agent applies the search 'as user types' fix in Header.jsx, retest by typing 'Malbec' in the search input and asserting product count drops to 1 without pressing Enter. Backend test file is /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. WhatsApp redirect is via window.open; tests stub it via window.open override and assert POST /api/orders returns 200.
rca of the issue: Live search failure RCA: In /app/frontend/src/components/Header.jsx the Input handler is `onChange={(e)=>setLocalSearch(e.target.value)} onBlur={()=>setSearch?.(localSearch)}`. setSearch (parent) is only invoked on blur/submit, so the useMemo filter in Storefront.jsx never recomputes while typing. Mitigation: change to `onChange={(e)=>{setLocalSearch(e.target.value); setSearch?.(e.target.value);}}` (or debounce 200 ms).
